note: Novated lease provider rules for home charging claims, as ChargeBack ships them (LeaseProvider.swift). Not downloaded by ChargeBack yet: an approved change here still needs an app update until the app reads this file. Every rule needs a source on the provider's own pages or forms.

providers.title: Smartsalary / Smart Leasing

flatRate: Smartsalary's EV Homecharging Expense Claim Form, with opening and closing odometer readings and dates
Lodge it in your Smart account or the Smart Salary Packaging app
actualCost: Charging data from a dedicated meter or your home charger
Smartsalary doesn't accept a household meter on its own

providers.notes: Per-km 5.47c (guide 4 Aug 2026), for fully electric cars. Actual cost needs a dedicated meter; household meter cannot be used. PHEV claim process not stated.

providers.title: Maxxia / RemServ / Oly

flatRate: Maxxia's Electric Vehicle Home Charging Rate form, with your odometer at 1 April and now, sent by email or post
Keep an odometer logbook, and one electricity bill if they ask
actualCost: Metering from your home charger or a separate smart meter
An electricity bill showing your cost per kWh, uploaded under EV charging

providers.notes: Shortcut 4.2c to 31 Mar 2026, 5.47c from 1 Apr 2026, pure EVs only. Eligible PHEVs can use the invoice (actual cost) method. One method per FBT year.

providers.title: Paywise

flatRate: Odometer photos at the start and end of the period
actualCost: Your charging records and your electricity bill

providers.notes: Per-km 5.47c from 1 Apr 2026 (4.2c before), not for PHEVs. Actual cost from app or meter records plus a bill; PHEVs claim actual cost. Same method all FBT year.

providers.title: Easi

flatRate: Easi's EV Charge Claim form with a photo of your odometer
Easi asks for claims each quarter
actualCost: Easi's EV Charge Claim form with a photo of your odometer
Easi asks for claims each quarter

providers.notes: Per-km only (support page 5.47c; the claim form still says $0.0420). PHEVs claimable per km.

providers.title: ORIX

flatRate: Your odometer reading in ORIX's online declaration each quarter (March, June, September and December)
actualCost: Your odometer reading in ORIX's online declaration each quarter (March, June, September and December)

providers.notes: Home charging per km only, 5.47c. 'By Receipt' covers public charging only. PHEV not stated. Method changes only at 1 April.

A copy of your electricity bill, in your name at your home address
Add a Budgeted Electricity (Fuel) budget first, then claim in mySG
actualCost: Opening and closing odometer readings (declaration)
A copy of your electricity bill, in your name at your home address
Add a Budgeted Electricity (Fuel) budget first, then claim in mySG

providers.title: Novated Lease Australia

actualCost: Before and after odometer photos, through the NLA app

providers.title: FleetPartners

flatRate: Your odometer reading at the end of March each year
actualCost: Your odometer reading at the end of March each year

providers.notes: Per-km (EV FAQ says 4.2c, personal-benefits FAQ says 5.47c). Actual cost not stated. No home charging claims for PHEVs.

providers.title: Fleetcare

flatRate: A photo of your odometer
Fleetcare usually pays per-km claims at the end of the FBT year
actualCost: Receipts or invoices for your charging
Home charging tracked by a smart meter or a separate circuit
Submit through the Fleetcare Novated Lease Portal

providers.notes: Shortcut (FAQ still says 4.2c) or invoice method; home charging at actual cost only if tracked by a smart meter or separate circuit. Blog (1 Jul 2025): hybrids and PHEVs don't qualify. One method per FBT year.

providers.title: Toyota Fleet Management

flatRate: Toyota Fleet Management's form TFM024, with your odometer at 1 April and 31 March
An EV odometer declaration, with a photo or screenshot of the closing odometer
An electricity bill for your home, dated within the period, that you're named on or share (with solar, a net cost)
actualCost: Toyota Fleet Management's form TFM024
Receipts or a bank statement showing what you paid
Receipts for any public charging not paid with the TFM EV Charge Card

providers.notes: Form TFM024 (07/2026). Per-km 5.47c from 1 Apr 2026, battery EV only. Actual cost for plug-in or battery EVs. Choose one option only.
